description: Template configuration matching manuscript Table S1 parameters. Set beta (y_damage_distribution_exponent) and tau (tax_equity) for desired scenario.

scalar_parameters._psi1: Linear climate damage coefficient, deg C^-1 (zero in DICE-2023)
scalar_parameters._psi2: Quadratic climate damage coefficient, deg C^-2 (DICE-2023)
scalar_parameters._eta: Elasticity of marginal utility of consumption
scalar_parameters._rho: Effective pure rate of time preference, yr^-1 (DICE-2023 risk-adjusted rate)
scalar_parameters._mu_max: Maximum abatement fraction. Values > 1 allow net-negative emissions.
scalar_parameters._y_net_reference: Reference income for damage power-law scaling, $/person (global mean 2020)
scalar_parameters._y_damage_distribution_exponent: beta: damage distribution exponent. 0 = uniform vulnerability (DICE default), 0.5 = increased low-income vulnerability, 1.0 = equal absolute damage
scalar_parameters._tax_equity: tau: tax progressivity in [0, 1). 0 = flat tax, 0.5 = progressive tax, ~1 = highly progressive tax. eta_eff = 1 + tau/(1-tau) * (eta-1)
scalar_parameters._income_dependent_aggregate_damage: If false, aggregate damage fraction depends only on temperature (DICE-like); if true, aggregate damage decreases as world gets richer
scalar_parameters._use_empirical_lorenz: If true, use empirical Lorenz curve fitted to World Bank data (G_b = 0.6813); if false, use Pareto-Lorenz
scalar_parameters._t_base: Base year. Time functions receive (t - t_base).
scalar_parameters._loose_epsilon: Convergence tolerance for Brent's-method root solve

A._description: Total factor productivity, Gompertz: A(t) = 4.907e6 * exp(ln(739.6/4.907e6) * exp(-0.0015 * (t-2020)))

sigma._description: Carbon intensity of GDP, tCO2/$, Gompertz

emission_ratio._description: CO2-equivalent to CO2 ratio. 1.40 at 2020, declining per DICE-2023

Eland._description: Land-use emissions, tCO2/yr. 5.9 GtCO2/yr at 2020, declining at 2.1%/yr (DICE-2023)

integration_parameters._n_quad: Gauss-Legendre quadrature nodes for income distribution integrals

optimization_parameters._n_points_final_f: 24 control points for log10(carbon price), distributed 2020-2220
optimization_parameters._initial_guess_f: log10(MAC in $/tCO2). 2.5 = $316/tCO2 initial guess (avoids near-zero abatement trap)
optimization_parameters._initial_guess_s: Initial savings rate guess. Presence enables dual optimization of f and s.
optimization_parameters._n_points_final_s: 24 control points for savings rate, distributed 2020-2220
optimization_parameters._bounds_s_note: FREE savings rate — Stage 0 test whether the [0.2, 0.4] constraint drives fig6 bumps
